name: Kaylis
title: Le prochain pas
story: Au départ de chez Madania, à Durane, Kaylis ajuste ses armes avant de gagner la Tour de Fer.

storyReference.title: Une rencontre retrouvée
storyReference.note: Scène inspirée du départ chez Madania. Cape, coiffure et seconde rapière ajoutées à la demande du joueur, non présentées comme des détails déjà écrits.

prompt: Create ONE completely new standalone vertical 4:5 Kalistar illustration, ideally 1122x1402. Illustration only, no card frame, text, UI, watermark. Reference 1 is Kaylis's canonical identity and painterly style; reference 2 shows her established clothing and rainbow tattoo identity in another scene; reference 3 is the precise white rapier design, Promesse Blanche; reference 4 is Momo, the golden standard for visible brushwork and narrative painted materials. Preserve Kaylis's recognizable face, warm olive complexion, brown eyes, dark hair, established athletic feminine proportions. She is an adult woman. Give her a beautiful confident badass glow-up, alluring through charisma, elegant posture and well-fitted existing clothing, never a pinup or exaggerated anatomy. Keep her dark fitted sleeveless high-neck combat top, slim waist, dark practical cargo trousers and laced combat boots from reference 2. No dress, new breastplate, bikini or nudity. Her bare arms retain precisely the flowing luminous rainbow vine tattoos, controlled multi-colored light with individual red, gold, green, cyan and violet regions, not huge ribbons around her body. Hair: intricate beautiful tight scalp cornrow braids sweeping backward and joining long thick dark braids behind her shoulder, no huge curly ponytail. Add a magnificent deep scarlet hooded traveling cape, slightly weathered heavy woven fabric, Little-Red-Riding-Hood silhouette interpreted seriously for Kalistar. The generous hood is pushed back behind her head so all her face and scalp braids remain visible. Cape opens at the front and falls behind both arms and both hips, its wind-lifted edge adds motion without hiding her equipment. Two rapiers are FULLY SHEATHED, one on each side of her belt, coherent two-point leather suspension. On her left hip: Promesse Blanche from reference 3, beautiful white braided hilt, fine silver filigree swept guard, iridescent pommel, long slender ivory-white scabbard with silver fittings. On her right hip: a unique black and crimson rapier with blackened metal swept guard, elegant red inner curves and ruby pommel, long straight black scabbard with narrow crimson inlays. Clearly TWO separate sheathed swords, NO drawn blades, NO katana, NO floating hilts, no third sword. Scabbards and hilts align as real straight swords and extend naturally alongside her outer legs; never curve or shorten a sword to make it fit. Scene inspired by the actual Story chapter 13: leaving Madania's modest maintained home in Durane before approaching the Iron Tower. Quiet repaired stone door surround and a broad cool-gray intact wall, a few shallow iron-edged steps, pale morning light in the street. No giant castle skyline, no ruins, no crowded props, no flags or extra characters. Kaylis descends one step in an assured measured stride, torso in three-quarter view, head turned toward the street ahead, fierce calm focus and an almost imperceptible knowing half-smile. One hand naturally checks a belt strap near the white rapier, the other hangs relaxed outside the cape. Natural fingers, balanced arms, believable walking weight, both feet visible. Camera far enough back for head, hips, complete sword fittings and boots with breathing room; no extreme wide-angle foreshortening. Frame her face and arms clear of future card-side stat zones. Premium narrative DIGITAL PAINTING, substantial intentional painterly strokes, rich worn cloth and metal, believable painted anatomy, cinematic cool daylight and warm reflected light on her face. Advanced post-apocalyptic fantasy with discreet technological clasps, not sleek sci-fi. No photorealistic rendering, no plastic 3D, no anime or flat cartoon, no uniform grain/noise overlay. The person is the emotional focus, background large simple forms.
